scope: Real installed CLI execution against deterministic owned OpenAI-compatible HTTP responses; transport/config/edit evidence, not model quality or real token usage.

corrections.finding: Aider discovers parent Git root before --no-git and can load parent dotenv/model settings.
corrections.fix: Private bare repository setup with child GIT_DIR; private HOME; system/global Git config disabled.
corrections.verified: Latest smoke includes conflicting owned parent .env and Aider config; fixture receives explicit key/model/endpoint.

corrections.finding: Cline --json rejects absent positional prompt before consuming stdin. Initial FIFO-only explanation was incorrect; upstream accepts file or pipe.
corrections.fix: Constant non-sensitive positional prompt plus actual task on stdin. Runner also handles real FIFO input concurrently.
corrections.verified: Latest Cline fixture completes with actual task transported on stdin.

corrections.finding: Cline provider schema rejects +00:00 timestamp offsets, silently discarding the provider file and selecting default API endpoint.
corrections.fix: Write millisecond ISO timestamp ending Z, matching upstream.
corrections.verified: Installed @cline/core StoredProviderSettingsSchema returns false for offset timestamp, true for Z; latest fakeprovider receives expected auth/model.

corrections.finding: Cline starts automatic update checking at startup.
corrections.fix: Set verified CLINE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 in childenv to preserve pinned installation.

unexpected_unauthenticated_request.detail: Invalid provider timestamp caused an unauthenticated default OpenAI request and an authentication error. No owner credentials were copied, no successful model inference occurred, and no paid inference was performed. Subsequent Cline fixtures add test-only macOS loopback egress enforcement.
